<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/v1.0/audits/policies"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Retrieves all asset audit policies configured for the current site and product. Audit policies define rules and schedules for verifying asset locations, conditions, and compliance. Each policy includes configuration such as the policy type, affected asset groups, verification schedules, alert settings, and assignee information. This endpoint returns the complete set of active audit policies that govern asset verification workflows in your organization.
